adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` inside the updated logic that processes multiple calendar references, the code does `for (const reference of calendarReference) { ... if (!credential) { const credentialFromDB = await prisma.credential.findUnique(...) ... } result.push(updateEvent(...)) }`. Even though `updateEvent(...)` calls are pushed without awaiting (allowing later concurrent `Promise.all` elsewhere), each missing-credential case awaits `prisma.credential.findUnique` sequentially in the loop, creating an N+1/serialized DB lookup pattern across references. This is a real, diff-grounded performance/architecture concern (batch fetch or pre-map credentials), not a correctness defect.
